messages.author: Kevin Hauser
messages.body:
Hi Amberites,
Has anyone managed to build a server with 10x RTX3090s and they’re happy with it? Does the problem of power persist if we go with 3080s instead (
http://archive.ambermd.org/202101/0328.html
)?
I found one vendor that said they’d hook me up with a 10x RTX3090 server but I’d like to hear your opinions on why this is a bad idea before I move forward. Are there new cards coming out? Is a new version of pmemd.cuda going to make a different architecture a “better” choice? Is custom fabrication required even for the 8x RTX3080/90 setups that folks are using?
Thanks everyone!
Best,
Kevin
